Circular No. 2006/44 (i)
Secretaries to the Provincial Public Service Commissions
All Chief Secretaries to the Provincial Councils
All Secretaries to the Provincial Ministries of Education
All Provincial Directors of Education
All Zonal Directors of Education
Providing a Financial Incentive for Principals and Teachers serving in difficult schools
The Circular No. 2006/44 dated 27.11.2006 issued in relation to the above matter is amended as follows.
Accordingly, the proceedings should be made to provide this allowance with effect from 01 April 2026 for officers serving in all National and Provincial Schools named as very difficult and difficult.
a. The Principals and Teachers in Very Difficult Service - Rs. 4000/- (Monthly)
b. The Principals and Teachers in Difficult Service - Rs. 3000/- (Monthly)

gold.issuedBy: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education
gold.targetAudience: Provincial Public Service Commissions, Chief Secretaries to Provincial Councils, Provincial Ministries of Education, Provincial and Zonal Directors of Education
gold.title: MOE Circular 2006/44(i): Financial Incentive for Principals and Teachers in Difficult Schools

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.content: Amends Circular No. 2006/44 dated 27.11.2006 to revise monthly allowances for principals and teachers serving in schools classified as difficult or very difficult, aligned with Budget 2026 provisions.

sections.heading: Key requirements
sections.content: Pay a special monthly allowance from 01 April 2026: Rs. 4000 for Very Difficult Service and Rs. 3000 for Difficult Service, for principals and teachers in all National and Provincial Schools so classified, subject to Education Circular 01/2024(I) and future amendments.

sections.heading: Legal & circular references
sections.content: Circular No. 2006/44 dated 27.11.2006; Circular No. 2006/44 (i); Education Circular 01/2024(I).

sections.heading: Deadlines & dates
sections.content: Allowance effective from 01 April 2026; original circular dated 27.11.2006.

sections.heading: Responsible parties
sections.content: Provincial and Zonal Directors of Education must implement payroll changes; approvals referenced from Director General of Management Services, National Budget, and Establishments.

actionItems: Update payroll to pay Rs. 4000 (very difficult) and Rs. 3000 (difficult) monthly from 01 April 2026.
Verify which schools are classified as difficult or very difficult under Circular 01/2024(I).
Inform eligible principals and teachers of the revised allowance.
File Circular 2006/44(i) with the original Circular 2006/44.
